items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And I made the soundtrack for "Houseboat" with Cary Grant and Sophia Loren.

ctx.x: Well, you were making good money then.

Oh, yes. And Dave Klein he's the one that -- and I made the soundtrack for a lot of the movies, "Step Down to Terror" with Richard -- Anthony Quinn. And I made the soundtrack for "Houseboat" with Cary Grant and Sophia Loren. Jane Powell, the girl most likely -- Nelson Riddle scored all the music for that.
Did you appear in any of these?
